title: Why Is Jesus Called Immanuel?
thread: About 700 years before Jesus, King Ahaz of David's family was afraid of war; God said fear not and offered any sign, and Ahaz refused (Isaiah 7:2-12); in that same war Ahaz begged the king of Assyria, I am thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me, paying with gold from the house of the LORD (2 Kings 16:7-8); God gave the sign anyway: a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel (Isaiah 7:13-14); 700 years later it came true: Mary, a virgin, was with child of the Holy Ghost, and the angel told Joseph, thou son of David, fear not, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins (Matthew 1:18-21); Joseph obeyed (Matthew 1:24); Matthew says Emmanuel means God with us (Matthew 1:23); Jesus died for our sins and rose on the third day (1 Corinthians 15:3-4) and promised I am with you alway (Matthew 28:20)
